overview.title: Green space in the planned town
overview.p1: Source Vittel is one of the pleasant public parks that make Ifrane feel different from denser Moroccan cities. Trees, paths and a spring give a short, calm walk without leaving the centre.
overview.p2: It is ideal after the stone lion or before a café stop. Families use it; photographers use the greenery as a soft contrast to Atlas day trips.
overview.p3: Thirty to sixty minutes is enough. Combine with the lion and a town avenue loop.

food.title: Eat near Source Vittel
food.p1: Centre cafés are a few minutes away. The park itself is for walking, not dining.
food.p2: Picnic rules vary — keep it light and clean if you snack on a bench.
